outcome_analysis: Sprites is an active AI marketing agent whose YC page claims 50 plus customers and 30M of annualized spend under management. The record is unclear on its history since the YC page lists founded 2025 against a Winter 2022 batch, and no outside funding was verified. It is therefore hard to say whether it succeeded, so the story is open rather than a result.
